_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — AR Invoice Payment Links UI per REQ-APL-008. Adds a Payment Requests overview (index over PaymentRequest with a state filter incl. an exceptions filter for failed / captured_unapplied, per-administration scope) + a Payment Request detail page (state badge, the paymentLink with copy + QR, expiry, regenerate action, failure reason, request history). One menu entry under the existing AR / Bookkeeping group (order 24). NOTE: the invoice-detail payment panel itself is described here as a sidebarProps tab note — the AR invoice detail page is owned by bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core, so the panel is additive/deferred to that page; this fragment ships the standalone overview + detail pages and the menu entry.

filters.label: Exceptions only
filters.description: Surface failed and captured_unapplied payment requests for operator action.

config._note: A payment request is a payment-gateway TRANSACTION against an AR invoice: a hosted payment link with a state machine (pending → authorized → captured / failed / expired), captured amount, gateway fee and settlement reference. Body leads with the invoice/amount data, the copyable payment link with QR, and an amount KPI; the Regenerate action mints a NEW request (history preserved). Prior attempts for the same invoice live in the Request-history sidebar tab and the immutable audit trail sits beside it. No email/calendar leaf — a financial transaction, not a comms surface.

actions.label: Regenerate payment link
actions.description: Creates a new pending payment request for the current outstanding amount. The panel shows its link, and the expired request stays visible in the history: this writes a new record rather than changing the old one.

props.description: Every payment request raised for this invoice. Expired and failed attempts are kept, so the history stays complete.

props.text: The invoice-detail payment panel (state badge, link + copy + QR, expiry, regenerate, failure reason) is additive to the AR invoice detail page owned by bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core and is deferred to that page. This fragment ships the standalone Payment Requests overview + this detail page. See REQ-APL-008.
